method.method_draft: First describe the image: R_B is on the line at bus B looking toward bus C, with the relevant downstream load marked 100 A at C. Infer a 100/5 CT for R_B. Use the maximum fault current at bus B, 2000 A, because the asked operating time corresponding to the standard answer is for the maximum fault level. Convert the primary fault current to relay secondary current: I_sec = 2000 × (5/100) = 100 A. Then PSM = 100/5 = 20. Substitute TMS = 0.1 and PSM = 20 into t_op = 0.14*TMS/(PSM^0.02 - 1), giving about 0.226 s, rounded to 0.23 s.
